keyword: buy M9 plaster sprayer not a concrete pump

title.en: An M9 Order Is a Plaster Sprayer, Counted in Litres per Minute
title.zh: M9 的订单是石膏喷涂机，单位是升每分钟

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the M9 at 30 L/min, 380 V / 50 Hz, hose 25 mm and particle ≤4 mm. That is not a trailer pump’s m³/h cell.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 M9 印成 30 L/min、380 V / 50 Hz、软管 25 mm、粒径 ≤4 mm。这不是拖泵的 m³/h 格子。

h1.en: Buy the M9 Only If the Sheet’s Units Match
h1.zh: 只有单位对得上，才购买 M9

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the M9 automatic plaster spraying machine apart from concrete pumps. The buying cells are 380 V / 50 Hz, 30 L/min, 50 bar, hose 25 mm, hopper 115 L, loading height 90 cm, 50 m / 20 m and particle ≤4 mm. The frame printed in the product introduction is 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm and 200 kg. If your order is in m³/h of concrete, this is the wrong page. The page is quote-only.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把 M9 自动石膏喷涂机与混凝土泵分开列出。采购格是 380 V / 50 Hz、30 L/min、50 bar、软管 25 mm、料斗 115 L、装料高度 90 cm、50 m / 20 m、粒径 ≤4 mm。产品介绍里印的外形是 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm、200 kg。如果你的订单是混凝土的 m³/h，这一页就不对。该页只询价。

heading.en: Do not convert 30 L/min into a pump name
heading.zh: 不要把 30 L/min 换成泵的名称

body.en: The figure 30 on this sheet is litres per minute, not Diesel 30 and not Electric 30. Those trailer pages use m³/h.
body.zh: 这一页上的 30 是升每分钟，不是柴油30，也不是电动30。那些拖泵页用的是 m³/h。

body.en: M9 is one of the pages that prints both voltage and frequency: 380 V / 50 Hz. Most trailer electric pages do not. Do not paste this pair onto Electric 20.
body.zh: M9 是同时印出电压和频率的页面之一：380 V / 50 Hz。多数电动拖泵页没有。不要把这一对贴到电动20上。

body.en: “M9 path, plaster, ≤4 mm, 30 L/min, 380 V / 50 Hz.” Send it to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery has no printed M9 price.
body.zh: “M9 路径，石膏，≤4 mm，30 L/min，380 V / 50 Hz。”发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械没有印出的 M9 价格。

question.en: Is the hopper 115 L a concrete-pump hopper?
question.zh: 115 L 料斗是混凝土泵料斗吗？

answer.en: No. It is the M9 plaster hopper.
answer.zh: 不是。它是 M9 的石膏料斗。

question.en: Is 50 bar the same as 5 MPa on a trailer?
question.zh: 50 bar 等于拖泵上的 5 MPa 吗？

answer.en: Do not convert it. The sheet prints 50 bar. Trailer pages print MPa on their own cells.
answer.zh: 不要换算。该页印的是 50 bar。拖泵页在自己的格子里印 MPa。

question.en: Can I order M9 for 4 cm aggregate?
question.zh: 能用 M9 订 4 cm 骨料吗？

answer.en: The M9 particle cell is ≤4 mm, not 4 cm.
answer.zh: M9 的粒径格是 ≤4 mm，不是 4 cm。

alt.zh: M9 石膏喷涂机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
